balls.text: a sumptuous stroke to end what has been a sumptuous innings! Trademark Shashank Singh, sprinkled with all the innovation possible in cricket's redefined textbook. Shimmies across to the off side, anticipating the full and wide ball, and laps it clean over short fine leg. PBKS finish with 236!
banged into the track just outside off and this takes Stoinis by surprise. He is rushed on the pull and can only cloth it on the bounce to long on

creamed over cover! Avesh makes the mistake of going wide, and pays the price! A wide half-volley and Stoinis is sweating on that sort of ball. Clean swing through the ball and this sails over the deep cover fence!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Stoinis clinks it right off the toe-end and chips it over the bowler. Shashank hurtles back for two and Stoinis completes it at the other end as well
fullish outside off. Stoinis goes back and across and hacks it enough to long on's right. Back for a brace
very full on off. Shashank sits deep in his crease and digs it out towards long on. Good start to the over by Avesh

and he does not need a sighter! Short and wide, and this sits up for the batter. Stoinis waits on it and then thunders it to cover point's right. The sweeper had no chance, and the 19th ends with a boundary!

the notebook celebration is out, and that means Rathi has another wicket, and it is that of the set batter! Slanted across full just outside off. Prabhsimran brings out the switch hit but does not connect the way he wants. Off the bottom part of the bat and Pooran swoops forward at extra cover to gobble up the chance. Prabhsimran is disappointed but he can be proud of his efforts - he has taken PBKS beyond 200 and within range of 230!
was that a chance?! Back of a length outside off. Shashank swings for the hills and seems to get an outside edge that is grassed by Pant. Tough chance, though. That was a thick edge
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran gets down on one knee and hacks it towards long on
back of a length hung up wide outside off. Prabhsimran swings his blade like an axe and only swats away a few flies in the process
on a length on middle and leg. Shashank presses half forward and pushes it to long off's left. The two is on but Prabhsimran slips while turning
back of a length delivery angled across the batter wide outside off. Shashank swishes at it and misses. Called a wide

oh my days - this is a shot and a half! Another missed wide yorker and Prabhsimran climbs into it. Sits deep in his crease but the torque through his hips and his bat swing makes this stroke possible. Clean swing and he carves this over wide long off!

four more! Avesh does not know where to look, and he probably does not know where to bowl too! Misses the wide yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side. Prabhsimran swishes at it with everything he has and the ball flies off the outside edge past short third!
pick the bones out of that one too! Slower ball that sits in the surface and then sits up just outside off. Prabhsimran cannot believe his luck and wallops it over cow corner!
low full toss on middle and off. Shashank shuffles across and tugs it towards deep mid wicket

edged and four! LSG bleeding runs now! Full and wide again and unless Avesh nails the wide yorker, it will always be a boundary-scoring chance. Shashank swings at it with all his might and skews it over backward point!
short and a mile outside off. Shashank lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
oh my - what a shot that is! Full and wide outside off. Shashank moves across his stumps, unfurls the reverse-ramp and nails it over short third!
slanted in full on middle and leg, bowled at 139.5kph. Shashank flicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
shortish outside off. Shashank gets up on his toes and cuts it uppishly towards deep point. A bit of a misfield and that makes the second a much more comfortable exercise
bye bye ball, and call a taxi to fetch that one back! This is short and slanting down leg. Right where Shashank wants it and he demolishes it over fine leg. Onto the roof and away into the mountains!
goes a mile up and lands into vacant space! Off-pace on a back of a length on middle stump. Shashank gets under it completely and drop-kicks it right between deep mid wicket and long on
oh, how has that missed?! Slower ball on a fullish length just outside off. Shashank has a wild swing at it and misses. Another coat of paint on off stump and it would have been pegged back...

oh dear - that is sloppy! Follows the batter outside leg with a hard length delivery. Shashank tugs it round the corner towards fine leg, where Avesh makes a complete mess of it. Does not pick it early enough and then cannot bend down in time!
top yorker to finish the over. Just outside off and Shashank can only squeeze it out to backward point
full outside off. Prabhsimran sits deep in his crease and powers it down the ground to long off

just over the leaping fielder! Slower bumper outside off. Prabhsimran picks it early enough and nearly swings himself off his feet. Does not middle it entirely but it has enough muscle behind it to clear Pooran, who did everything to try and rein it in!
into the blockhole on off stump. Shashank jams down on it and digs it out towards mid wicket

bowled'im around his legs, and Wadhera's cameo has been cut short! Sizzling yorker on leg stump. Wadhera tries the cute, little paddle round the corner but probably picks the wrong ball to do so. Too full to be playing that stroke and he does not get any bat on it. Hears the death rattle soon after and no real celebration from Prince Yadav. That could still be a vital wicket, though, given how Wadhera had begun!
almost a yorker on middle and off. Prabhsimran still cannot get under it and drills it back past the stumps. Just a single
back of a length just outside off. Wadhera stays back and pokes it towards the bowler, who misfields slightly. Wadhera wants to run on it but his partner says no
shot! Back of a length outside off and this sits up to be hit. Wadhera uses the width on offer and blazes it past extra cover. Markram had no chance at long off either!
flighted up full outside off. Prabhsimran lunges forward and knocks it to long on. Happy with a single after two sixes in the over
six more! Exactly the same stroke, and exactly the same result! Angled in again, and into the slot on leg stump. Prabhsimran picks it up on the sweep and slams it over deep backward square leg!
on a length just outside off. Prabhsimran reads the away-going delivery off the pitch and can do nothing but defend
high into the night sky and deep into the stands! Darted into the slot on middle and leg. Prabhsimran gets down on one knee and smokes it over deep backward square leg!
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Wadhera does not pick the variation early and is also beaten by the slight extra bounce. Past the shoulder of the bat and that will be a dot
as nonchalant as you'd like! In the slot just outside leg and Wadhera capitalizes. Gets down low, snaps his wrists into action and helps it over the fine leg fence!
banged into the track outside off. Wadhera ducks under it and then sees the square leg umpire stretch out his arms
short and wide outside off. Prabhsimran does well to reach it but cannot do much with it apart from that. Dabs it uppishly to deep point
slower bumper wide outside off. Prabhsimran shapes for the uppercut but has no pace to work with. Plays and misses
back of a length on leg stump. Wadhera lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards deep square leg
full outside off. Prabhsimran sits deep in his crease and drills it towards long off
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran goes back and plays with the spin, easing it towards deep backward square leg
another drag-down outside off. Wadhera waits for it and cuts it powerfully towards cover, who gets down low to his left and saves three
back of a length outside off. Wadhera goes back and taps it towards extra cover

Wadhera says hello to Rathi with a boundary! Short and wide outside off. Wadhera reaches out for it and slaps it past extra cover. Markram sprawls to his right after running around from long off and gets a hand to it, but can only push it into the ropes!

six and out, and Rathi has his man! The first time Shreyas has fallen to spin this season too! Floated up on a fullish length outside off and this seems to shape away or spin away just a little. Shreyas, looking to go inside-out, slices across it too much and lobs it towards backward point. Mayank does the rest and the Rathi notebook celebration is out, with that celebration taking place on his hand instead of the turf. Shreyas departs for 45 but not before injecting momentum into this innings!
of course he does! Rathi tries to follow Shreyas outside leg but this is in the slot and into the hitting swing. A clean pick-up through the line and the ball soars over long on!
off-pace and dug into the track outside off. Works out perfectly for Prince because Prabhsimran is shaping to scoop it. The lack of pace means he makes no contact
juicy full toss on off stump but Shreyas misses out. Perhaps taken by surprise a little and he stabs it back past the bowler for a single
back of a length outside off. Shreyas hangs back and jabs it towards backward point
up and over! Shreyas is on the charge now! Another attempted yorker that ends up as a slot ball, angling into off stump. Shreyas plants his front foot and lifts it comfortably over mid off!
shortish just outside off. Shreyas opens up his stance and tugs it to long on's right. Samad cuts it off but not before Shreyas canters back for two
the new bat works a charm straightaway! Right in the slot outside off. Shreyas establishes a strong base, goes through the line and launches it over long off!
short outside off. Shreyas jumps up onto his toes and cuts it towards deep point. Keeps strike too
banged into the track with more conviction but this sails harmlessly over the batter's head. Called a wide. That was bowled at 135.7kph
hard length, 136.5kph, honing into off stump. Shreyas gets tucked up on the pull and scuffs it back towards the bowler

slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran plays it late and runs it down to deep third. Brings up his seventh half-century in IPL cricket, his third on the trot this season, and this one has come off 30 balls!
dug into the track just outside off. Bowled at 134.8kph and this rushes Shreyas on the pull. He shanks it to mid on and dashes across to the other end
Shreyas with a much-needed boundary! Full and slanting into the pads. Shreyas picks the line up really early and clips it effortlessly to mid on's right. That was bowled at around 137kph!
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran taps it towards extra cover and calls for the single early. Has to scurry but makes it comfortably in the end
back of a length just outside off and this keeps a little low. Shreyas has a stab at it hurriedly but the ball squirms under the toe-end of his bat
hard length just outside off. Prabhsimran drops it into the backward point region and saunters across to the other end
dug into the track outside off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and slaps it towards extra cover
banged in short outside off and this sails over the batter's head. Shreyas lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide
slow and short outside off. Prabhsimran gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards backward point, whose slight misfield allows the single. Badoni the guilty party
shortens the length after seeing the batter advance. Prabhsimran has a swish at it anyway but fails to lay bat on ball. That fizzed past his flailing blade
leg-cutter on a back of a length just outside off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point for a sharpish single
very full outside off. Shreyas opens his bat face this time and guides it towards deep point
fuller outside off. Prabhsimran presses forward and pushes it towards mid off for a single
top shot! On the shorter side and offering a teensy bit of width. Prabhsimran cashes in and places it perfectly between deep cover point and backward point!
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran takes a step down the track and swishes at it wildly. Only connects with fresh air
cleverly done! Banged into the track outside off and Prabhsimran telegraphs this. Waits for the ball and then, nonchalantly, ramps it over the keeper's head!
back of a length in and around off. Prabhsimran lets the ball come to him before cutting it off the stumps towards backward point
slow and short wide outside off. Prabhsimran sits deep in his crease before dabbing it towards backward point. He will feel he missed out there
short and wide again. Shreyas hangs back in his crease and jabs it powerfully towards deep point
smashed! Dug into the track outside off. Shreyas fights the angle a little but still manages to muscle it over mid on. Not the cleanest of connections but Shreyas will not mind the result!
short and wide outside off. Shreyas goes back and across before cutting it to deep point's left. Good work by Miller to ensure it is just a brace
slower ball on a length outside off. Prabhsimran plays with soft hands and nurdles it towards backward point
length just outside off. Shreyas transfers his weight forward and drives it on the up towards long off
on a length just outside off. Sticks in the surface a touch and Shreyas chips it over the bowler's head for a single
fuller outside off. Prabhsimran lunges forward and turns it towards long on
full just outside off. Shreyas presses forward and eases it down the ground to long off
back of a length just outside off. Prabhsimran stays back and knocks it towards long on
Prabhsimran is not sparing Rathi either! This is a very clever stroke. Shortish outside off and Prabhsimran uses the softest of touches to steer it behind point!
on a length outside off. Shreyas gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards deep point
authoritative with a capital A! Back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran spots the length early, stands up tall and mauls it over the bowler's head!
fuller outside off. Prabhsimran gets onto the front foot and drives it past extra cover for a couple of runs. Not the cleanest of connections, though
short and wide outside off. Prabhsimran cuts it towards backward point, who dives sharply to his left and saves four. Markram the fielder

goes a mile up, and goes shelled at mid off! Slot ball outside off and Prabhsimran tries to hit that into the mountains. Cuts across it too much and Pooran, settling under it, makes an absolute meal of it. He never established a solid base and could not hold on
back of a length outside off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and jabs it towards backward point
short and wide outside off. Prabhsimran hangs back and cuts it towards deep point
slower ball on a full length wide outside off. Prabhsimran waits for the ball to arrive before tapping it towards backward point
off-pace on a back of a length on off. Shreyas drops it into the off side with soft hands and gets across for an easy single
Shreyas is up and running too! Back of a length, angling across the batter outside off. Shreyas uses the width and slaps it past extra cover!

taken on the fence, and Inglis has to depart after a sprightly cameo! Slower ball dug into the track on middle stump. Inglis' eyes light up and he thinks there is a six for the taking. Swipes at it and gets decent contact but does not get the elevation he is after. Miller, stood on the deep mid wicket fence, extends his arms fully over his head and completes the catch, while also ensuring he does not step onto the fence. Two wickets in three overs for Akash, and PBKS lose their second!
cutter on a back of a length on middle and off. Inglis shapes for the cut but does not have as much room to work with. Swish and a miss

and he gets pumped over his head! PBKS have come out swinging! Right in the slot outside off and Akash gets met. Absolutely met. Inglis bends his back knee a touch, goes through the line and slams it over the long off fence!
four to finish the over, and Mayank has been ripped apart so far tonight! On the shorter side again and offering width. Prabhsimran waits on it and chops it between backward point and short third!

fetch that too, says Prabhsimran Singh! Another slower ball and this is getting a little predictable now (although never thought we'd be able to say this about Mayank Yadav). Prabhsimran lines it up and slugs it over mid on!
slower delivery dug in short on middle and leg. Prabhsimran backs away and hacks it in rather agricultural fashion towards mid wicket
watch that ball sail into the sea of red! Short and wide outside off, and Prabhsimran climbs into it. Throws the kitchen sink at it and flays it over backward point!
back of a length on middle and off. Prabhsimran gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
hard length outside off and this takes off. Prabhsimran looks to dab it fine but is beaten by the extra pace and lift
off-pace and dug into the track outside off. Inglis gets up on his toes and jabs it towards cover point. A two-run over to follow up a six-run over - solid work by Akash Singh!
slower ball on a fullish length outside off. Prabhsimran waits for it and runs it down to short third
just over! Off-pace on a length outside off. Inglis looks to go inside-out but is too early into the stroke. Scuffs it uppishly towards Pooran at mid wicket and just clears him

oh dear - where are you going, Josh Inglis?! Slower ball on a length on the pads. Inglis plays it to mid wicket and sets off for the single. Prabhsimran does not move a muscle at the other end and a direct hit by Pooran would have been curtains for the Aussie batter
well well! Back of a length just outside off. Inglis makes up his mind to play the reverse but fails to make contact. Ambitious stroke, it must be said
full and swinging into middle and off. Inglis stays leg side of the ball and drives it straight to extra cover. He timed that well too but just could not get the placement he wanted
angled in on a fullish length just outside off. Inglis presses forward and tips it to mid on before haring across to the other end. Sharp, sharp single
banged into the track again outside off (surprise, surprise). Bowled at just 133.8kph, though, and Inglis is a touch early into his pull. Only a fresh-air shot

three sixes in a row, and this has been palmed over the bar on the fence! Mayank dares Inglis to make it three pulls out of three and Inglis says thank you very much. A bit more of a shank, which brings Avesh into play at deep mid wicket but he can only parry it over the fence!

Stop everything folks, Inglis has come to play tonight! Marginally short outside off and right where Inglis wants it. He rocks back and like Ricky Ponting used to in his heyday, belts it over mid wicket!

oh my goodness - Inglis is taking no prisoners! Another short ball outside off and this sits up for Inglis. He hops up onto his toes, lifts up his front leg Calypso style and dumps it over square leg!
banged into the track wide outside off. Prabhsimran reaches out for it and cuts it down to deep third. Bowled at 141kph
oh, hello! Fullish just outside off, shaping back in slightly. Does not matter to Inglis, though. Does not matter to him one bit. He leans forward and cracks it past extra cover. No one moved!

straight to the sweeper, and Arya bites the dust in the first over! Akash Singh has a wicket in his first over, and LSG are underway! On a length, swerving away wide outside off. Arya was always going to go after it but the late swing means he slices it a touch. Arrows it straight down Mayank's throat at deep backward point and LSG are on the board very early!
on a length, curving back into the batter. Prabhsimran lets the ball come to him before helping it into the mid wicket region
angled in full on middle and off. Arya gets onto the front foot and works it towards deep square leg to get off the mark
back of a length outside off, swinging away again. Arya has a slash at it (of course he does) and only connects with the fresh mountain air
back of a length outside off. Shapes away nicely and Arya is happy to let it go. Well, that is a collector's item first up!

A win almost 12 years in the making! It was a dismantling of the Mumbai Indians then, and a thumping of the Lucknow Super Giants now! The Punjab Kings snap their home hoodoo at Dharamsala and move up to second, and within a point off the top of the table, beginning this home stretch as if they mean to go on! This is perhaps slower and even wider than the previous ball. Avesh swishes at it and pops it towards Shreyas, who jumps up into the air but cannot make it stick. A dropped catch to end the evening, but this was a complete performance by the Punjab Kings - the sort of display that has just reiterated their title credentials!
four more! Thrown up full and wide and Avesh is ready for this too. Steps down the track and obliterates it over extra cover!
follows Avesh way outside leg with a length ball. He swings at it because, well, why not, and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
clean strike! Shortens the length after seeing Avesh advance, but he adjusts superly to still belt this over the bowler's head for a maximum!
tossed up full on middle and off. Prince plants his front foot and drills it towards long off

Chahal bags Badoni, and that will be that for a brilliant innings! Low full toss just outside off. Badoni, ambitiously, looks for the reverse but gets into an awkward tangle. The ball skews off the leading edge and Arshdeep does the rest at short third. Chahal finally gets himself on the board, and LSG will not be able to celebrate more Badoni boundaries tonight!
zipped in full, and this tails in late. Avesh continues swinging without a care in the world and gets beaten by the late movement into him
banged into the track outside off. Avesh gives himself an enormous amount of room and then shanks his swipe. Goes high up but enough to mid off's left
full and wide outside off. Badoni throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep backward point
another exceptional stroke! Misses the wide yorker by just a bit and that is enough for Badoni. He gets down on one knee early, having moved across, and sweeps it flat over the deep square leg fence!
back of a length outside off. Avesh gives himself room and swings from the hip. Toe-ends it down the ground to long on
streaky but they all count! And these runs are hurting PBKS now, in an NRR context! Bumper on leg stump. Avesh backs away and swings like a rusty gate. The ball flicks the top edge and races away
banged into the track on middle and leg. Badoni has a swipe across the line and gets beaten by the extra bounce
four more! Shortish and following the batter outside leg. Too far down leg, though, and that allows Badoni to whip it away behind square!
dug into the track just outside off. Badoni gets up on his toes and pulls it over square leg. The sweeper comes around from deep mid wicket and saves two
well, that is why he did not want to go off strike! Another slot ball, this time wide outside off. Badoni goes through the line and carves it over extra cover!
on a length on middle and off. Badoni flicks it down the ground to long on and says no to the single
Badoni with another maximum, and he brings up his fifty too! Back of a length outside off. Badoni stands up tall and bulldozes it over long on!
Avesh is off the mark with a boundary! Slower ball that lands right in the slot on middle and off. Avesh backs away and thunders it past mid off!
banged into the track on leg stump. Avesh has an agricutlural swipe at it and makes no contact, unsurprisingly

straight back at Jansen, and those bucket hands clasp around it! Hard length just outside off. Samad opens up his stance and hacks it towards the bowler. Jansen reacts in time and gets his hands in the right place, and once that happens, he usually makes the ball stick. Might have been a slower one which deceived Samad, adn he has to walk back after a 24-ball 45, which has certainly reduced the margin of defeat for LSG!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Badoni digs it out into the backward point region and picks up a run
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Badoni stays back in his crease and swings it away towards fine leg
full on middle and leg. Samad clears his front leg and hacks it down the ground to long on
wild short ball bowled a mile outside leg. Samad can get nowhere near it but thankfully for PBKS, Inglis can. Just a wide
back of a length just outside off. Badoni opens up his stance, looking to tonk it into tomorrow, but only connects with the fresh Dharamsala air
safe again, Samad is riding his luck here! On-pace short ball on off that gets big on Samad. He splices his pull so terribly that it lands well inside the ring in the wide mid on region
slower bumper on middle and off that takes at least a week to arrive. Badoni waits and waits and waits and waits and waits for it before upper-cutting it towards deep third
safe again! Full toss in and around off stump. Samad looks to go inside-out but miscues. Luckily for him, it does not carry to Stoinis at extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Badoni has a stab at it and jams it off the inside edge. The ball rolls into the off side for a single
fullish on the pads. Badoni sits deep in his crease and flicks it away towards fine leg. Good effort by Vyshak on the fence to save a couple of runs

oh dear - what has happened there?! Knee-high full toss Samad has an almighty swipe across the line. Goes straight up off the top edge and for the longest while, it seems he will be heading into the shed. But just as the TV camera pans to where the ball is landing, Wadhera is down on the deck, a little sheepish and completely done in by some loose footing. Not sure how to further describe that, but it might go down as a missed chance
serious whippage! Right in the slot on the pads, and that is too easy for Samad. He snaps his wrists into action and whips it over deep mid wicket!
carved away for four more! Samad knows the wide yorker is coming and sets himself up for it. Peels the outer cover off the ball and slices it past backward point!
full outside off. Badoni sits deep in his crease and drills it down the ground to long off
slow, short and Badoni would have needed a ladder to get to that. Loops harmlessly over his head and is called a wide
into the blockhole, targeting the stumps. Samad cannot get under it and digs it out towards long on

polite enquiry for a caught-behind, but the umpire signals a wide! Banged into the track and sliding just down leg. Samad looks for the pull and gets beaten by the extra lift. Seems to go over his glove but the umpire is happy to call it a wide
full and wide outside off. Badoni moves across his stumps and gets down low to shovel it towards deep mid wicket
full and wide outside off. Badoni has another swish at it and flays it down to deep third. Good recovery by Vyshak to close out the over
short and wide outside off. Samad throws his hands at it and slices it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Badoni chops it down to deep third
another trademark Badoni shot! On a length outside off. Badoni shuffles across his stumps early and laps it excellent. Lands just before the cushion on the fine leg fence!
on a length just outside off. Samad taps it towards extra cover and saunters across to the other end
shortish outside off. Samad gets up on his toes and punches it enough to deep point's right for a brace

back of a length wide outside off. This sneaks just inside the tramlines and Badoni does not get the wide he wants after letting it go. But he is adamant it should be a wide, and he reviews. Could be a futile one. And it indeed is. Enough of the ball is inside the guideline, and LSG are out of reviews!
fullish ball on leg stump. Badoni gets down on the sweep and helps it behind square. Stoinis does some good work on the deep square leg fence and saves two
back of a length on off. Samad lets the ball come to him before turning it into the mid wicket region
oh, this is going to bring rain! Another proper slot ball outside off. Samad gets down on one knee and smokes it clean over long on. That is a mighty hit!
slower, floatier and wider outside off. Samad shapes for the reverse and even though he makes decent contact, he cannot beat backward point
right in the slot, and Samad pummels it! Not great bowling, it must be said. Allows Samad a free swing through the line and he smacks this over the sightscreen!
back of a length wide outside off. Touch-and-go on the tramlines but the umpire calls it a wide after Samad lets it go
four more! 21 off the over! Dug into the track outside off. Badoni leaps up onto his toes and upper-cuts it sweetly over short third!
shortish outside off and this kicks up a little, while also nipping away. Badoni goes following it away from his body and is beaten on the outside
short, wide and punished again! This is on-pace and Badoni can then access the region behind point. Waits for it and scythes it away, giving the deep point fielder no chance!
oh, what a shot! Badoni continues to fight! Slot ball on middle and leg. Badoni gives himself room early and gets his hands through the ball, caressing it beautifully over extra cover!
back of a length outside off. Samad gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep point
and Vyshak gets smashed for a six first ball! Slow, short and wide, and begging to be hit. Samad obliges and forehands it flat over long off!

another short ball, slanting across the batter outside off. Samad has a swipe at it and heaves it towards long on, where the fielder slips initially but recovers in time. The ball had also plugged in the outfield, making the recovery more feasible
fullish on middle and off. Samad gets onto the front foot and plays it gently back to the bowler
dug into the track outside off. Samad opens up his stance and hacks it towards mid wicket
thumped! Back of a length outside off and Samad has had enough of the pushing and prodding. He skips down the track and hammers it over mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Samad has another tentative prod at it and chunks it off the inside edge towards the keeper
back of a length on leg stump. presses half forward and drops it into the on side

back of a length on middle and off. Samad has a nibble at it and jams it off the inside edge into his thigh pad. The ball dribbles away into the off side for a run. Given as a leg bye, though. So, the umpire thinks there was no bat involved at all

Omarzai has another, and LSG's freefall continues! Back of a length delivery angled across the batter outside off. Miller throws the kitchen sink at it but ends up slicing it too much. That brings deep point into play and Shashank, like he did for the Pant dismissal, makes absolutely no mistake. LSG slide further into trouble, and PBKS can sense their seventh win of the season now!
hard length in and around off stump. Badoni skips down the track and drills it towards deep point
short and wide outside off. Badoni goes fishing at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air. Lets out a grunt of frustration too soon after
shortish outside off. A bit of extra bounce and Miller punches it uppishly towards sweeper cover
back of a length on middle and off. Miller gets behind the line and taps it down the ground
shortish outside off. Miller hops back and jabs it towards extra cover, who dives sharply to his right and ensures it is just a single
back of a length on off. Badoni stays back and punches it towards long on. He wanted two but Miller sent him back, quite audibly
slowed up on a back of a length wide outside off. Spins away further and ends up beyond the tramlines. Some more exercise for the umpire
tossed up fuller and wider outside off. Miller reaches out for it and drives it to long off
Kaboom! Miller with his first maximum! Floated up, right into the slot on leg stump. Miller plants his front foot, gives himself swinging room and dumps it over deep mid wicket!
flighted up full on the pads. Miller comes forward and works it into the gap between deep backward square leg and deep mid wicket. Easy brace to get off the mark
back of a length just outside off. Badoni hangs back and turns it towards deep square leg
banged into the track on off stump. Miller gauges the length early enough and ducks under it

Pant loses his bat, and loses his wicket as well! And LSG may have lost this game too! Angled across on a fullish length just outside off. Pant hares down the track and then throws his bat at it (quite literally too). The bat ends up at square leg, and the ball ends up in Shashank's hands at deep point. Omarzai in on the wicket-taking act, and LSG are now four down inside eight overs!

Pant sprawls to make his ground! Shortish and sliding down leg. Badoni has a swipe at it and misses. Inglis dives to his left to collect and then has to get up to hurl the ball at the batter's end. Pant pinches an extra run
back of a length outside off. Pant presses half forward and dabs it past backward point
back of a length on leg stump. Pant gets into an awkward position but manages to tug it away between deep square leg and fine leg. Back for a brace
fuller and wider outside off. Badoni throws his hands at it and laces it towards deep point
innovation at its best! Back of a length outside off. Badoni shimmies across his stumps early and scoops it away. One bounce and into the fine leg fence!
dispatched! A poor over ends with a drag-down just outside off. Pant opens up his stance and thumps it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Pant hangs back and dabs it towards short third
length ball down leg. Pant gets bat on it but cannot beat the fielder at short fine leg. He will be disappointed with that effort. A massive cheer goes around because Vyshak fielded that cleanly!
angled in on a back of a length on off. Badoni waits for it and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Pant gets down on one knee and swipes it towards deep backward square leg. Vyshak nearly messes this up too, but recovers in time

oh dear - that is not great fielding! Shortish and spinning into the pads. Pant tugs it towards deep backward square leg. Vyshak tries to pick it up one-handed and makes a complete meal of it. Not sure he will want to look back at that again...
jaffa! Hard length on middle stump and this curves away devilishly. Badoni, having taken a step down the track, fences at it and gets beaten all ends up
back of a length outside off and this shapes away late. Badoni goes feeling for it and is beaten by the late movement
that is some shot! Back of a length outside off. Sits up a little and that is all Badoni needs. He stands tall and crrrrrrunnnnnnnchhhheessss it over the wide long off fence!
short and a mile outside off. Badoni lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length outside off. Badoni hangs deep in his crease and guides it to deep backward point's left. Canters back for two
just short! Back of a length just outside off. Nips away a touch and that squares up Badoni. He nibbles at it and the edge falls in front of short third
back of a length outside off. Badoni advances and throws his hands at it, only to swish at thin air
oh! Back of a length just outside off. Pant has a tentative nibble at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. The ball rolls away just past the stumps
back of a length in the fifth stump channel. Gentle shape away and Pant leaves this alone
on a length just outside off. Pant wants to drop and run to point but his partner is not as interested. Gets sent back and he has to scurry to regain his ground
hard length just outside off. Badoni rises with the bounce and jabs it into the off side to get off the mark

full and hung up wide outside off. Badoni thinks about throwing his hands at it initially before letting it go. Badoni and Pant want the wide, and it looks like they have reviewed. This could be touch-and-go. No part of the ball is inside the tramlines and LSG are vindicated. Wide given!

plumb with a capital P, and Nicky P has to go back for an early shower! Zipped in full on middle and leg. Pooran has a swipe across the line and misses. Gets pinned on the back leg right in front of the stumps and the umpire's finger is up in a jiffy. Pooran wants to have another look, but all signs are that this is a wasted review. Clear gap between bat and ball. Ball Tracking comes up now and...it shows the ball to be thundering into leg stump. Pooran has to go, and he takes a review along with him!
that has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Rank half-volley outside off and Pooran takes full toll. Plants his front foot and blasts it to mid off's right!
well well! Back of a length on middle and off. Pant looks for that famous fall-over scoop of his and misses it altogether. Bounces just over the stumps
bang! Pant lands his first punch! Length ball swinging away outside off. Pant dances down the track, goes through the line and slams it over mid off!
dug into the track outside off. Pant arches his back, trying to upper-cut it but ends up chalking it off the toe-end towards slip
hard length just outside off and this gets big on Pant. Gets big on him long before he realizes and he hurriedly defends it towards the bowler. He was probably aiming square of the wicket
back of a length outside off. Pant presses half forward before watching it go through to the keeper
pushed in on a length just outside off. Pooran has a wild slog across the line and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. The ball bobbles away towards point for a single
length ball outside off that shapes away nicely. Pant is happy to let this go

chopped on, and Arshdeep is wreaking havoc with the new ball. And in other news, grass is green! Dug in shorter and this is angled across Markram. He looks for that trademark back-foot punch but does not come to grips with the movement. Only manages an inside edge that crashes into the stumps, and Markram is livid with himself. Arshdeep will not mind, though. He will not mind it one bit. Arshdeep has two, and LSG in some early strife!
swerved in full on middle and off. Pooran tips it to mid on and scampers across to the other end
back of a length, swinging back in sharply towards off stump. Pooran gets behind the line and defends

goes a mile up, and nestles into the graceful palms of Nehal Wadhera! Huge wicket! On a length on the pads. Marsh steps down the track and gets under it completely. The ball goes so high that it comes down with snow on it and when it does, Wadhera is there to accept the offering in the deep square leg region. Holds his nerve, holds on to the catch, and Marsh is outta here!
angled across on a length outside off. Marsh has an ungainly slog across the line and only grabs a handful of fresh air
back of a length on leg stump. Keeps a little low but because Markram is behind the line, he can stab it towards mid wicket
hard length on leg stump. Skids onto Markram, while also nipping back. Cramped for room, Markram taps it towards the bowler

up, up and away! Length ball pushed across the batter outside off. Markram marches down the track and throws the plumbing at it. A bit of a skew off the outside edge but it carries all the way over deep backward point!
back of a length on the hips, shaping back. Markram plays all around it and the ball dribbles off the thigh pad into the on side. Markram calls for the second and hurtles back to complete it
peach! Back of a length on off and this does not shape in, instead going on with the angle. Markram plays for the inward swing and gets squared up. Beaten on the outside
shortish ball down leg and that is easy pickings for Markram! He uses the pace on offer and glances it away fine. Fine leg was too square to hunt it down!
ripper! Back of a length in the channel and this decks away sharply. Marsh gets opened up like a deck chair and is lucky to not nick it
full and swinging into middle and leg. Marsh comes onto the front foot and pokes it towards mid on
back of a length outside off. Leaves the batter and Marsh is happy to let it go through to the keeper
fullish on off and this swerves away late. Markram opens his bat face and runs it down to deep backward point
in-swinging yorker on the pads. Markram tucks it off his toes towards deep square leg and gets off the mark with a brace
back of a length, starting just outside off and shaping back in. Markram is tucked up for room on the cut and scuffs it back to the bowler
